questions.question: What did God command about where to worship and sacrifice?
options: On every hilltop all throughout the land
At any high place they wished to use
In the private homes of each family
At the one place the LORD would choose
questions.answer: At the one place the LORD would choose

questions.question: What were they to destroy in the land?
options: The pagan places of worship and idols
Their own altars and high offering places
The crops and orchards of the land
The walls and gates of the cities
questions.answer: The pagan places of worship and idols

questions.question: They were forbidden to eat blood.
They were to bring their offerings to the _____ the LORD would choose.
They were not to eat the _____, for it is the life.
